assertion.statement: For the smaller-support Selmer complex over an admitted imaginary quadratic K with omega(k)<=A and j derivative labels, a finite free model has total rank at most56omega(2N)+8A+56j+70.
assertion.objects: Residual W=E[2]=F2², the global complex and actual derived local conditions at2N, moving and derivative primes.
assertion.hypotheses: Full rational two-torsion, finite free model transport, Kummer theory, global/local Euler characteristic and cohomological dimension, and the displayed derived local conditions are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: Every admitted K and fixed finite set of j derivative labels, at each finite coefficient stage.
assertion.parameter_range: Imaginary K, omega(k)<=A; ramified primes added only to the global estimate do not impose new Selmer local conditions.
assertion.uniformity: Bound independent of active-prime count, moving prime and order of the finite moving character; this stage bounds only the smaller-support model.
assertion.constants: With v=omega(2N),m=v+1+j,s<=v+A+1+j, global dimension<=8s+2, finite local total<=48m and archimedean allowance<=4; the stated coarser bound is56v+8A+56j+70.
assertion.normalizations: Count ranks in all degrees of one complex, not size of its entire diagram. Derived Kummer keeps degree-zero torsion; derivative conditions retainD0 and the relaxed condition omitsD2.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The genus argument includes dyadic ramification and quotient class groups. Complex conjugation transport is not an extra real local condition; no infinite real periodic resolution is counted.
assertion.limit_order: Bound global residual cohomology using S-units and genus, then Euler characteristic; count actual local complexes; transport finite models and form the cone before further cancellation.

assertion.statement: After the retained inner limit and inversion of t, the original-support complex has the bounded smaller-support generic residual cohomology; binary minimal ranks over F2((t))[G] equal augmented cohomology dimensions, and scalar O-minimal ranks obey the same bound.
assertion.objects: Original and smaller-support complexes, actual support-comparison maps and homotopies, scalar or binary coefficient ring and its augmentation.
assertion.hypotheses: The smaller-support rank bound, unramified support comparison and full graph odd-exponent moving-character prescription are supplied; retain a fixed finite support through the inner limit.
assertion.quantifiers: Each admitted finite active support and binary group, after its actual retained inner limit.
assertion.parameter_range: Scalar characteristic-two coefficients or binary coefficients followed by augmentation; then invert t.
assertion.uniformity: The resulting minimal-rank bound is independent of active support. No support-uniform bound for the whole comparison diagram is asserted.
assertion.constants: The bound is56omega(2N)+8A+56j+70; active blocks use A=D=((1+t)^e-1)I with e odd.
assertion.normalizations: Reduction mod2 alone does not kill a binary character. Augment first for the residual computation; F2((t))[G] is local with nilpotent augmentation ideal and ranks are module ranks, not dimensions over F2((t)).
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not invert t in finite Artin coefficient rings. The full retained diagrams can grow with G and support even though minimal ranks satisfy the bound.
assertion.limit_order: Reduce and augment where needed; retain actual maps and homotopies; take the inner limit; invert t and contract active blocks; obtain minimal ranks by unit cancellation.
